issue.title: ref_library migrate_tasks worktree_snapshot panics NotFound when a transient .git file vanishes mid-walk

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposing bead: bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.land (lander of epic bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5), found while reviewing base-branch CI for integration drift. Not caused by that epic: the failing SHA a75c55f9 predates it.

Observations (bob-cli GitHub CI, job `test (macos-latest)`):
- FAIL run 40190123972 on a75c55f9: `ref_library::migrate_tasks::unmapped_refuses_write_and_map_wins` panicked at tests/cli/ref_library/migrate_tasks.rs:105:46 with `read: Os { code: 2, kind: NotFound }` (2049 passed, 1 failed). The ubuntu job in the same run passed.
- pass on the next master SHA f4f6a9ca (run 40191854741, both OSes). That commit changes only src/ lib-test helpers and does not touch this test.

Root cause (confident from the source): `worktree_snapshot` (migrate_tasks.rs:112) calls `vault_snapshot`, which walks the whole vault including `.git/` and `fs::read`s every file. Only afterwards does it filter out `.git` entries. A transient git file (a lock, or a temp object or pack written by a git child of bob or a detached auto-maintenance) can be listed by `read_dir` and gone before `fs::read`. That gives the NotFound panic at line 105, inside the very snapshot whose `.git` content is thrown away. Fix: prune `.git` during traversal in `worktree_snapshot` (do not descend into `.git`), keeping the "writes nothing" equality on the work tree unchanged. Then audit the sibling copies in tests/cli/ref_library/{migrate_zorg,show,list,find}.rs for the same walk-then-filter pattern. Do not swallow NotFound for work-tree files, which would mask real writes.

Fail rate: 1 observed failure; it passed on rerun at the next SHA. Not reproduced locally (Linux `just check` at f4f6a9ca passed).
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: cargo test --test cli ref_library::migrate_tasks (macOS CI; full-suite load)

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli macOS CI on a75c55f9 failed this test with a NotFound read inside the work-tree snapshot; the next SHA passed. Nothing tracks it, and the snapshot helper's walk-then-filter pattern is copied into four sibling test files.

payload.description: Need task c2 defect details for migrate-snapshot-prune phase

payload.entry: Fixed by batch 9 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.5 in bob-cli f255819a. Every ref_library snapshot walker (migrate_tasks, migrate_zorg, show, list, find, today; rename and mod already pruned) now prunes .git during traversal. migrate_zorg's silent read-skip became expect, so work-tree writes cannot be masked. No test compared raw .git bytes. The lander reran cargo test --test cli ref_library -- --test-threads=64 four times alongside full loaded CLI suites: 132/132 passed each time. bob-cli CI 40196386071 on 6292c35b passed.
